keyword.zh: 电动20和电动40混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动20和电动40混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 20 prints one distance pair and an 80 mm pipe. Electric 40 prints two stone rows and does not print a pipe diameter.
description.zh: 电动20印一组距离和 80 mm 管径。电动40印两行石子距离，不印管径。

h1.zh: 电动20和电动40混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 20 and Electric 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, distance 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm and aggregate 1–2 cm. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. Both pages use 120 m as a horizontal figure, on different rows.
directAnswer.zh: 电动20和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动20印 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、距离 120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m。电动20的 120 m 是唯一一组里的水平侧。电动40的 120 m 是细石行里的水平侧。

heading.en: Where Electric 20 and Electric 40 print different values
heading.zh: 电动20和电动40哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 20 prints 22 kW; Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h; Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 20 prints 10 MPa; Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 20 prints 0.25 m³; Electric 40 prints 0.4 m³. Dimensions: Electric 20 prints 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm; Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Main unit weight: Electric 20 prints 900 kg; Electric 40 prints 2300 kg. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动20印 22 kW；电动40印 45 kW。理论输送量：电动20印 8–10 m³/h；电动40印 21 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动20印 10 MPa；电动40印 23 MPa。料斗容积：电动20印 0.25 m³；电动40印 0.4 m³。外形尺寸：电动20印 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm；电动40印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。整机重量：电动20印 900 kg；电动40印 2300 kg。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 20 prints cells that Electric 40 does not: Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m; Delivery pipe diameter 80 mm; Max. aggregate size 1–2 cm. Electric 40 prints cells that Electric 20 does not: Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动20有、电动40没有的行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 40 m；输送管内径 80 mm；最大骨料粒径 1–2 cm。电动40有、电动20没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The same metre number can sit on a different row. Keep the row label with the number. Open /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20 and /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 同一个米数可能落在不同的行上。数字要和行标题一起看。看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/，看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 20 print the same motor power as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动20和电动40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 prints 22 kW. Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20印 22 kW。电动40印 45 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 20 print the same theoretical output as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动20和电动40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20印 8–10 m³/h。电动40印 21 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 20 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动20和电动40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 prints 10 MPa. Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动20印 10 MPa。电动40印 23 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is pumping distance (h / v) missing on Electric 40?
question.zh: 为什么电动40没有输送距离（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric 40 page does not print that label. Electric 20 prints 120 m / 40 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动40这一页没有印这个标题。电动20印的是 120 m / 40 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
